notes: Â§27.1 isolated-boundary sample is 100000 resolutions per test point; this run used 100000.
Capability movements are exact functions of the ratings and carry no interval. Probability movements are sampled and carry Wilson intervals.
Box-score, role-relative, team-impact, and fatigue/availability observables are NOT covered by this run; they require the match-level suite.
